name: enter-fold
description: Start The Fold REPL daemon and login, or restart if already running. Use this skill at the start of any session working with The Fold, or when the REPL needs to be restarted.
instructions:
# Enter The Fold

This skill handles the complete setup of The Fold REPL environment, including Chez Scheme installation in cloud environments.

## Cloud Environment Detection

First, detect if running in cloud:
```bash
uname -s  # Linux = likely cloud
scheme --version 2>&1  # Check if Chez installed
```

If on Linux and `scheme` not found, assume cloud environment.

## Install Chez Scheme (Cloud Only)

If in cloud and Chez Scheme not installed:
```bash
cd /tmp
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/cisco/ChezScheme.git
cd ChezScheme
./configure --installprefix=/usr/local
make -j$(nproc)  # Takes ~2-3 minutes
sudo make install  # Takes ~1 minute
scheme --version  # Verify installation
```

**Important**: Use appropriate timeouts:
- `make` command: 300000ms (5 minutes)
- `sudo make install`: 120000ms (2 minutes)
- Git clone: 60000ms (1 minute)

## Start The Fold Daemon

```bash
# Create REPL directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p .fold-repl

# Start daemon (works on Unix/Linux)
./daemon.sh start
```

On Windows: use `./DAEMON.cmd start` instead.

The daemon will start in the background and create:
- `.fold-repl/request.ss` - write Scheme expressions here
- `.fold-repl/response.txt` - read responses here
- `.fold-repl/daemon.pid` - daemon process ID
- `.fold-repl/daemon.log` - daemon logs

## Login to The Fold

Determine credentials from environment or use defaults:
```bash
FOLD_TIER="${FOLD_TIER:-sonnet}"
FOLD_NAME="${FOLD_NAME:-builder}"
```

Write login command:
```scheme
(hi 'sonnet 'builder "Entering The Fold")
```

Use the Write tool to write to `.fold-repl/request.ss`, then:
```bash
sleep 2  # Wait for response
cat .fold-repl/response.txt
```

## Verify Session

Write session check command:
```scheme
(who)
```

Then:
```bash
sleep 1
cat .fold-repl/response.txt
```

Expected output:
```
Logged in as: <name> (<name>)
Since: <timestamp>
```

## Success Criteria

- `scheme --version` returns version number
- Daemon running (PID in `.fold-repl/daemon.pid`)
- Login response received: "Logged in as..."
- Session verified with `(who)` command

## Notes

- Chez Scheme installation is one-time in cloud environments
- Subsequent runs skip installation if `scheme` exists
- Cloud environments need `sudo` for installation
- Always create `.fold-repl/` directory before starting daemon
